about.title: Seaside Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Seaside's crash reports show a familiar pattern: Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. bring the heaviest reported collision activity, especially along Fremont Boulevard, Del Monte Boulevard, Broadway Avenue, and Noche Buena Street. In 2025 alone, Seaside logged 88 injury collisions and 114 injured people, according to public crash records. Behind every one of those numbers is someone dealing with medical bills, missed work, and an insurance adjuster who may already be building a file against them. We handle car accident claims for Seaside residents. Our team can review the police report, talk with witnesses while memories are fresh, and handle communication with insurance carriers. Contacting us costs nothing, and we work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless your case results in a recovery. The sooner evidence is preserved, the stronger your position tends to be.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before the Insurer

items.title: California's Two-Year Clock
items.desc: Most car accident claims in California must be filed within two years, but if a government vehicle or agency was involved, that window can shrink to as little as six months. Missing it can end your case before it starts, so early legal guidance matters.

items.title: Comparative Fault Cuts Both Ways
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, meaning you can still recover damages even if you're partly at fault, though your share of blame reduces the payout. An attorney can help make sure fault isn't overstated against you in early insurer conversations.

items.title: No Cap on Pain and Suffering
items.desc: Unlike some states, California doesn't limit non-economic damages like pain and suffering in most car accident cases. That makes it especially important not to accept a quick, low settlement before the full extent of your injuries is known.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurance adjusters are trained to ask questions that can be used to minimize your claim later. Our team can advise you on what, if anything, to say.

items.question: What if my accident happened on Fremont Boulevard or Del Monte Boulevard and I'm not sure who was at fault?
items.answer: Fault isn't always clear right after a crash, especially on busy Seaside corridors with multiple lanes and driveways. We can request traffic camera footage, witness statements, and the official collision report to help sort out what happened. You don't need to have all the answers before reaching out.

items.question: Does it cost anything to contact your firm about my car accident?
items.answer: No. There's no cost or obligation to speak with us about your case. We work on contingency, so we only get paid if your case results in a recovery.
